name: self_v1_en
note: The English counterpart of self_v1, sentence for sentence: the same five concepts in the same order, degrading the same way when an answer is missing or non-substantive. Written against the schema's columns, so it renders any English-valued dataset - the English edition of the survey today, an English grid tomorrow. English needs no agreement, so its filters (years, in) see only their value.
sentences: I live {region|in}, in the {district} district, in a municipality of {town_size}.
My employment status is {employment_status} and my household income is {income_range}.
